verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a marketing line saying Hummingbird can 'streamline... ongoing monitoring' with customizable automation, plus a periodic case re-review feature. Neither documents a way for a compliance officer to turn ongoing screening on or off for selected customers. Generic monitoring claims and case-review scheduling are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can enable and disable ongoing screening for selected customers
